        int n = Integer.parseInt(input.split(" ")[0]);
        int bitCoins = Integer.parseInt(input.split(" ")[1]);
        String[] values = s.nextLine().split(" ");

        PriorityQueue<Integer> costs = new PriorityQueue<Integer>();
        int odd = 0;
        int even = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if (Integer.parseInt(values[i]) % 2 == 0) {
                even++;
            } else {
                odd++;
            }
            if (odd == even) {
                int diff = Integer.parseInt(values[i + 1]) - Integer.parseInt(values[i]);
                if (diff < 0) {
                    diff = -diff;
                }
                costs.offer(diff);
            }
        }

        int count = 0;
        while (!costs.isEmpty() && costs.peek() <= bitCoins) {
            bitCoins -= costs.poll();
            count++;
        }
        System.out.println(count);
    }
}
